items.title: Bobby Shew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 1, 2020
items.q: Marie and my wife and I we used to go out and go to dinner sometimes together.

ctx.x: Oh you should know him. That’s his mom. She’s his mom. Matt is a brilliant young saxophone player. He lives in Vegas, and a writer and all of that. He was on Louie Bellson’s band and all of that. Anyway, so Benny was the worst of them. You know Woody Herman was cool except that Woody could be really icy cold at times you know, and you know I’ve seen him downgrade Sal Nestico when we were on the band together. And Nat Pierce wrote a ballad for Sal, “Easy Living” I think it was, and Woody wouldn’t let him play it.…
